idempotencyFingerprint.canonicalization: Recursively sort object keys; preserve array order; reject non-JSON and non-finite values; UTF-8 encode; SHA-256 hash using lowercase hexadecimal.
idempotencyFingerprint.sameKeySameHash: Return the first logical result without repeating side effects.
idempotencyFingerprint.sameKeyDifferentHash: Return IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT without executing the operation.

recovery.eventOrdering: sequence is monotonically increasing within a session.
recovery.unknownWriteOutcome: Query authoritative session state; do not blindly repeat diagnosis or reward-affecting writes.
